title: The Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Rurban Mission (SPMRM):
summary: Schemes — The Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Rurban Mission (SPMRM):

items: Launched on 16th September 2015 by the Ministry of Rural Development, aims to bridge the rural-
urban divide by developing rural areas with urban amenities and services.
o Cluster-based development of 300 rural clusters, focusing on both plain coastal areas (25,000-
o Investment attraction through clusters, fostering economic growth and employment.
o Employment generation and poverty alleviation through rural development, infrastructure

o Integrated rural development with urban-like facilities (roads, water, sanitation, electricity).

increase rural prosperity, and promote balanced growth across India.
